Circularity is a shared responsibility.

Building a circular economy requires more than one stakeholder to play their part. But the circle cannot close if the consumer is left out.

Circularity does not end with packaging designed for recyclability or products reaching consumers. What happens after consumption matters just as much. Without effective collection and consumer participation, recyclable packaging can fail to reach recovery systems.

This is where a Deposit Refund Scheme (DRS) can make a difference. It gives consumers a defined route to return eligible packaging, supported by a refundable deposit, and can help turn responsible intentions into repeatable actions that connect everyday consumer choices with organised collection and material recovery.

Closing the loop is not only about designing packaging for another life. It is also about enabling people to help packaging reach the systems designed to recover its value.

Swipe through to see how participation becomes part of the system.
